title: Slipway site configuration
description: The _config.yml keys the Slipway theme reads. Other keys belong to Jekyll or to plugins and are allowed unchecked.

author.description: Author of the site, used in the feed and as the author in the JSON-LD of posts and docs. Either a name or an object with a name.

name.description: Author name, shown in the feed and the JSON-LD.

baseurl.description: Path the site lives under, such as /my-project, without a trailing slash; empty at a domain root. Jekyll's relative_url and absolute_url use it for every link.

description.description: One-sentence summary of the site, quoted under the title in llms.txt and llms-full.txt.

direction.description: Text direction of every page. Leave it unset to derive it from the language (rtl for fa, ar, he, ur, and other right-to-left languages). A page's direction in front matter wins.

lang.description: Default language of the site as a BCP 47 tag. A page's lang in front matter wins. It picks the interface strings, the date format, and the text direction.

slipway.description: Slipway's own settings. Unknown keys here are rejected, so a typo fails instead of being ignored.

plausible.description: The domain name of your site to enable Plausible Analytics.

url.description: The URL to the Umami script. Defaults to https://analytics.umami.is/script.js.

arabic.description: Opt-in Arabic conventions for pages whose lang is ar.

digits.description: Print dates, reading time, and section numbers with Arabic-Indic digits.

hijri.description: Print post dates in the Hijri calendar.

fonts.description: Font loading. default self-hosts the theme fonts; system downloads nothing and falls back to system fonts.

header.description: Header layout. classic puts the title at the start and navigation, search, and the toggles at the end; centered stacks them on the middle axis; minimal shows only the title, the language switcher, and the theme toggle.

languages.description: Languages of the site, in switcher order. Pages join by lang and translation_key in front matter. Leave it unset for a one-language site.

code.description: Language tag that pages use in their lang front matter, such as en or fa.

name.description: Name of the language in that language, shown in the switcher, such as فارسی.

prefix.description: URL folder of the language home, such as /fa; '' for the default language.

dark.description: Path to the dark-mode logo (shown when the dark theme is active), relative to the site root.

favicon_svg.description: Path to an SVG favicon, relative to the site root.

light.description: Path to the light-mode logo (shown by default), relative to the site root, such as /assets/img/logo.svg.

touch_icon.description: Path to an Apple touch icon (180x180 PNG), relative to the site root.

persian.description: Opt-in Persian conventions for pages whose lang is fa.

digits.description: Print dates, reading time, and section numbers with Persian digits.

jalali.description: Print post dates in the Jalali calendar.

social.description: Social icons for the links layout.

title.description: Accessible name for the social icon.

url.description: The URL of the social profile.

tokens.description: Overrides for theme tokens. Each key maps to CSS variables in tools/theme/config-map.mjs. An unset color keeps the theme's light and dark pair; a set one applies to both.

accent.description: Accent for links, marks, and filled buttons, in both light and dark.

canvas.description: Page background, in both light and dark.

text.description: Body text color, in both light and dark.

title.description: Site name, shown in the header, the page title, and the feed. The feed falls back to it when author is unset.

url.description: Scheme and host of the published site, without a trailing slash. Jekyll's absolute_url uses it for the feed, the sitemap, and canonical links; GitHub Pages sets it for you.

color.description: A hex color (#rrggbb) or an oklch() color.

length.description: A CSS length in rem, em, or px.
